answer: Witnessed Physical Relay. A registration is valid only when a fresh challenge nonce is carried by a short-range radio link across a lotus-shaped sequence of fixed relay nodes, each time-stamped at a distinct karst cave site; only a node physically present can inject the nonce at each hop. A prism check splits the path into independent channels and rejects any hops sharing a clock or radio fingerprint. Faking one identity requires physically occupying each relay site in sequence, so cost scales with travel and site rental per registration, not with compute.
